metadata.description: Claude Code mods by ccdwyer: guardrails, feedback loops and toys built on function hooks

plugins.name: review-ghost
plugins.description: Attaches a file's unresolved GitHub PR review threads to the model's Read and Edit results, so review comments get fixed in the file it is already touching

plugins.name: assertion-guardian
plugins.description: Blocks edits that weaken tests to fake a green run: removed or loosened assertions, added skips, deleted cases, swallowed errors, snapshot rewrites

plugins.name: budget-governor
plugins.description: Enforces session and daily spend caps: a live gauge above the prompt, a wrap-up nudge at 80%, and new prompts refused at the cap

plugins.name: secret-sentry
plugins.description: Two-way secret scrubbing: redacts credentials before the model sees them and blocks writing them into tracked files or shell commands

plugins.name: context-dungeon
plugins.description: A roguelike pane played by your real session: context is HP, errors spawn monsters, green tests slay them, commits open chests, PRs are floor bosses

plugins.name: red-squiggle
plugins.description: Type-checks and lints the file Claude just edited and puts the errors in that same tool result

plugins.name: dependency-bouncer
plugins.description: Vets npm and PyPI packages before they install: blocks hallucinated, typosquatted and brand-new install-script packages, flags risky ones

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Stops the agent repeating the same failing command or undoing its own edits, and shows a stuck meter above the prompt

plugins.name: inline-tribunal
plugins.description: A second_opinion tool and /tribunal command: your diff is reviewed by Codex and Grok side by side, read-only, inside the session

plugins.name: speedrun-splits
plugins.description: A LiveSplit-style timer above the prompt that auto-splits on recon, first edit, tests, green, commit and PR, with personal bests and gold segments

plugins.name: stack-traffic-control
plugins.description: A departure board for gh stack: live stack pane, a one-line status above the prompt, and raw force-pushes, rebases and PR base edits on stacked branches redirected to gh stack

plugins.name: redbox-relay
plugins.description: Attaches fresh React Native redboxes and native crash logs from running simulators and emulators to your prompt, and warns when an edit needs a native rebuild

plugins.name: proof-decay
plugins.description: Tracks which test, typecheck, lint and build results are still true after later edits, and stops commit messages that claim checks which are stale

plugins.name: quarantine
plugins.description: Wraps web, MCP and third-party tool output as untrusted data and defangs prompt-injection lines before the model reads them

plugins.name: boot-sequence
plugins.description: A BIOS-style boot screen when a session starts: real checks of git, toolchains, devices, ports, context and disk, typed out and flipped to OK, WARN or FAIL

plugins.name: diff-seismograph
plugins.description: A live braille seismograph of every edit above the prompt, quake alerts for big changes, and a heat treemap of the repo

plugins.name: departure-board
plugins.description: A Solari split-flap departure board for the agent's real work: tasks flip letter by letter in amber as they board, depart, get delayed or cancelled

plugins.name: transit-map
plugins.description: Your git history as a Vignelli-style subway map: branches are coloured lines, commits are stations, merges are interchanges, and your working tree is a train on the current line

plugins.name: fault-lacquer
plugins.description: Kintsugi for your session: failed operations crack a lacquer tile, and the run that fixes them repairs it with animated gold seams

plugins.name: netrunner-hud
plugins.description: A cyberpunk dashboard pane for your session: braille context gauge, live token oscilloscope, tool-call waterfall and git/test/job/cost widgets, animated at 30fps

plugins.name: mirror-pane
plugins.description: Before/after simulator screenshots on the same step as a UI edit, side by side in a pane, with a changed-pixel percentage and pinned baselines

plugins.name: codebase-galaxy
plugins.description: Your repo as a live force-directed starfield in braille: files are stars, imports are faint links, and Claude's attention is a comet that flies to every file it reads or edits

plugins.name: netrunner-trace
plugins.description: A live node map of every host your agent reaches: packets fly from your machine to github.com, npm, PyPI, MCP servers and unknown hosts, with a log and first-contact alerts

plugins.name: process-concierge
plugins.description: Gives every dev server, watcher and background process the agent starts an owner, a port and a stop button, and catches duplicate starts
